in_hebrew.name: Vally
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Valley of the wanderer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Vally הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'vallis' meaning 'valley', this name is a beautiful and meaningful choice for a baby girl. In the Bible, the valley often symbolizes a place of refuge, a place of growth, and a place of transformation. This name is perfect for a child who will wander through the valley of life, growing and transforming into the person God intends them to be.
